text:
```sql
SELECT 
    reparto,
    data,
    importo,
    SUM(importo) OVER (PARTITION BY reparto ORDER BY data) AS somma_cumulata
FROM 
    progetti
WHERE 
    data IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    reparto, data;
